name: Isoniazid + Rifampicin
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: Rifampicin about 10 mg/kg (450 to 600 mg) with isoniazid about 5 mg/kg once daily, on an empty stomach

key_interactions.effect: Large falls in exposure or hepatotoxicity.

key_interactions.action: Use non-hormonal contraception during and for 2 weeks after.

key_interactions.effect: Large falls in levels (rejection risk; adrenal crisis).

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Warfarin, azole antifungals, phenytoin, many others
key_interactions.effect: Lower levels by enzyme induction (S-warfarin AUC down 74%).

key_interactions.action: Give rifampicin at least 1 hour before.

serious: Stevens-Johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis, DRESS, acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis

pk.half_life: Rifampicin about 3 hours (2 to 3 hours with repeated dosing); isoniazid levels halve within about 6 hours (acetylator-dependent)
pk.metabolism: Rifampicin hepatic (potent inducer); isoniazid by acetylation (genetic)
pk.excretion_renal_pct: Rifampicin up to 30% in urine (half unchanged); isoniazid 50% to 70% in urine within 24 hours
